data_flow:
The README.md section will trace the end-to-end Phase 4 planner loop data flow as built:
1. Scope & Goal Capture (T1): A room is created and `scope.captured` is posted to `POST /rooms/:roomId/events` with `baseSha`, canonical scope `paths`, and `goal`. `prepareFounderGoal` scans `goal` for credential material and appends server-derived `founder_goal` evidence (`founderGoalDigest(goal)`).
2. Opening a Round (T2 or T4): In `PlannerLoop.runRound(roomId)`, if the room is in `SCOPED`, `openFirstRound` runs inside `ledger.appendDerived` under the room lock: it verifies T1 scope and goal digest, derives G2 facts (`rolesAssigned`, `reviewerIsNotBuilder` by comparing execution surfaces, and fence-derived `gatewayOnline`), appends T2 `task.dispatched.planner`, and atomically appends the `journaled` command row (`commandKind: 'planner.invoke'`, `roleId: 'architect'`, deterministic `commandId` from `plannerCommandIdFor`) via `journal.inTransaction(client).appendJournaled`. If the room is in `PLANNING`, `openNextAttempt` under the room lock journals attempt 1 of a revision round opened by T4 (reading and re-judging the prior plan from `PlanStore` via `earlierPlanOf` into `PlannerRevision` before journaling) or journals a governed retry when the prior attempt failed with `failureClassification === 'not_sent'` and `retryBudgetTransition` allows it (up to `MAX_ROUND_ATTEMPTS = 3`).
3. Pre-Send Checks, Attestation, and Dispatch: Before provider contact, `executeRound` checks `authorizeRoute`, calls `planner.attest(commandId)` over `GatewayPlannerChannel` (collected via signed `planner_poll` and answered via signed `planner_report`), verifies the attested `ExecutionIdentity` matches the intended route and `architect` role, and appends `identity_bound`. It then calls `planner.dispatch`; on the Gateway, `PlannerRecordStore` durably writes `starting` before `AgyPlannerExecutor` launches headless `agy` under `sudo -n -u <plannerUser>` against a read-only anonymous checkout of `baseSha`, holding the prompt back until the first stream-json `init` event confirms `init.model === 'gemini-4-argon-high'` (`AGY_PLANNER_LANE.agyModel`). If confirmed, the executor writes its durable evidence record, sends the work to standard input, and reports `accepted` with `observed` route and `PlannerInit` (`initModel`, `conversationId`); the control plane requires `PlannerInit` when `initRequired(observed)` holds (`antigravity` / `google`) and appends the `dispatched` row (`BRJ:c:2`).
4. Plan Evaluation and Atomic Submission (T3): `planner.awaitPlan(commandId)` polls `status` until the Gateway reports `finished`. `judgeRoundPlan` validates the returned document with `judgePlanDoc` (`PLANDOC_SCHEMA_V1`, canonical `scope_paths`, `planHash`, and `terminal_status === 'PLAN_READY_FOR_FOUNDER_APPROVAL'`) and checks that `repository`, `base_sha`, and `scope_paths` match/lie within the room's captured T1 scope (`isWithinScope`). On refusal, `logPlanRefused` logs `planner.plan_refused` with a value-free `PlanRefusalReason` and the loop appends `failed`. On acceptance, `submitRoundPlan` commits T3 `plan.submitted`, `PlanStore.recordPlan`, and the journal `completed` row (gated by `resolveCompletionAuthorization`) in one transaction, advancing the room to `PLAN_REVIEW`.
5. Plan Inspection and Founder Decision (T4, T5, T22): At `PLAN_REVIEW`, `GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan` serves the re-judged plan from `PlanStore`. The Founder submits a decision to `POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision` authenticated by `PHASE3_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN` and the exact `planHash`: inside `ledger.appendDerived`, `decidePlan` re-reads the plan under review from `PlanStore`, commits T5 `plan.approved` (to `BUILDING`), T4 `plan.revision_requested` with `feedback` (back to `PLANNING`), or T22 `founder.cancel` (to `CLOSED_ABANDONED`, marking any pending planner command `unresolved` with `unconfirmed-cancel` and setting `unconfirmedCancelRecorded: true` when non-terminal or `runningTasksCancelled: true` when terminal), and atomically appends the `decision` record to `JournalStore`.
trust_and_security_boundaries:
1. README.md authority boundary: README.md is descriptive only and creates no governance authority; the new section must state explicitly that the presence of the Phase 4 planner loop and counted-run harness does not authorize a Phase 4 counted run, close the Phase 4 stop gate, or authorize Phase 5.
2. Token separation documented in the section: `CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN` guards `/rooms/*` and `GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan`; `PHASE3_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN` alone guards `POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision` (never falling back to `CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN`); and `PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN_TOKEN` alone guards the three `/control-plane/rooms/:roomId/planner-round` and `/journal` counted-run routes (never opening `plan-decision`).
3. Secret hygiene and redaction: `prepareFounderGoal`, `JournalStore`, `PlanStore`, and `decidePlan` refuse credential-shaped strings via `containsCredentialMaterial`; `logPlanRefused` emits only schema property names, indices, counts, and status codes (`PlanRefusalReason`) and never echoes plan values; `phase4:counted-run` scrubs `CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN` and `PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN_TOKEN` from stdout and stored attempt logs.
4. Host isolation on Gateway `1880c12d`: `AgyPlannerExecutor` verifies the SHA-256 of the root-owned `agy` binary before every run, runs it as the dedicated unprivileged `plannerUser` via `sudo -n` with `PINNED_AGY_ARGUMENTS` (`--mode plan`, `--sandbox`), uses an anonymous read-only checkout removed after the run, and reaps lingering `plannerUser` processes via `pkill -KILL -u <plannerUser>`. A wrong `agy` hash, a failed launch, or a wrong or missing `init` refuses that run only; it writes `planner-halted.json` in the Gateway directory when the planner-user check before a start, the cleanup after a run (the reap, the checkout's removal, or confirming `agy`'s exit), or the writing or reading of its evidence record fails.

error_and_failure_behavior:
The planned `README.md` section documents the fail-closed error and failure semantics of the built planner loop:
1. Generic event route refusals: `POST /rooms/:roomId/events` returns 403 `governed_path_required` for `GOVERNED_PATH_EVENTS` and 400 `founder_goal_refused` for invalid or non-T1 goals.
2. Planner round outcomes (`PlannerRoundOutcome`): a round that cannot open returns `refused` (`not_plannable`, `round_already_open`, `round_failed`, `retry_budget_exhausted`, `guard_failed`, `not_leader`). Deterministic pre-send or post-send defects record `failed` with one of the twelve `PLANNER_FAILURES` classifications (`authorization_does_not_cover`, `authorization_indeterminate`, `attestation_failed`, `identity_mismatch`, `not_sent`, `route_mismatch`, `planner_reported_failure`, `plan_invalid`, `plan_outside_captured_scope`, `plan_refused`, `completion_not_covered`, `round_superseded`). Only `not_sent` is eligible for governed retry (up to 2 retries per round). When provider contact or completion outcome cannot be ruled out (such as a thrown `dispatch` or `awaitPlan`, or an accepted `antigravity`/`google` dispatch missing `PlannerInit`), the loop records `unresolved` rather than guessing.
3. Recovery and reconciliation (`PlannerRecovery`): `recoverRoom` refuses to run if `journal.verify()` fails or leadership is not held. For open `journaled`/`identity_bound`, `dispatched`, or `unresolved` commands, it reconciles from `planner.reconcile(commandId)` without re-executing; `ambiguous` or `mismatch` readings never resolve silently and leave the command `unresolved`.
4. Plan-decision and counted-run refusals: `POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision` returns 503 `plan_decision_disabled` when `PHASE3_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN` is unset, and 409 on `founder_cancel_unavailable` (no journaled planner command exists in `ROOM_CREATED` or `SCOPED`), `plan_hash_not_applicable`, `plan_hash_mismatch`, `plan_not_found`, or `journal_sequence_violation`. Counted-run routes return 503 `counted_run_disabled` or `counted_run_not_configured` until configured.

Step 2 — Add `### The Phase 4 planner loop — as built` under `## Status` in `README.md` immediately after line 143: Write a concise, structured subsection covering the built Phase 4 planner loop components and their exact file paths:
- **Governed event boundary and Founder goal (`packages/control-plane/src/governed-events.ts`, `packages/control-plane/src/founder-goal.ts`, `packages/control-plane/src/server.ts`):** `POST /rooms/:roomId/events` refuses `task.dispatched.planner`, `plan.submitted`, `plan.revision_requested`, `plan.approved`, and `founder.cancel` (`GOVERNED_PATH_EVENTS`) with `403 governed_path_required`. T1 `scope.captured` accepts an optional `goal` (up to 20,000 characters, credential-scanned by `containsCredentialMaterial`) via `prepareFounderGoal`, which attaches server-derived `founder_goal` evidence (`founderGoalDigest`).
- **Complete command-journal writer and chain verification (`packages/control-plane/src/journal-store.ts`, `packages/journal/src/index.ts`):** `JournalStore` serializes appends under advisory lock `JOURNAL_APPEND_LOCK_KEY` (`8_201_015`) and savepoint `journal_append`, supporting transactional `appendJournaled`, `appendCommandEvent` (`BRJ:c:2` via `encodeCommandEventRowV2`, carrying optional `initModel` and `providerConversationId` on `dispatched`), `appendDecision` (`encodeDecisionRecordRow`), `commandHistory`, cross-row sequence enforcement (`commandSequenceDefect`, `boundDecisionDefect`), contract §5.3 completion authorization (`resolveCompletionAuthorization`), and full-chain verification from genesis (`verify()`).
- **PlanDoc v1 judgment, durable plan store, and plan read route (`packages/seat-output-schema/src/plandoc.ts`, `packages/control-plane/src/plan-doc.ts`, `packages/control-plane/src/plan-store.ts`, `packages/control-plane/src/plan-read.ts`, `packages/control-plane/src/migrations.ts`):** `judgePlanDoc` validates against `PLANDOC_SCHEMA_V1` (`plandoc/1`), checks canonical `scope_paths` (`checkScopePaths`), computes `planHash`, and marks only `PLAN_READY_FOR_FOUNDER_APPROVAL` ready for decision. Migration `0010_plan_store` creates append-only table `public.build_room_plans` (`SELECT, INSERT` for `br_app_runtime`). `PlanStore.recordPlan` refuses credential-shaped strings and requires the referenced T3 `plan.submitted` event to be written in the same transaction (`e.xmin = pg_current_xact_id()::xid`) with matching `planHash`, re-judging and recomputing `plan_hash` on every read. `GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan` (behind `CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN`) serves the room's latest T3 plan.
- **Governed planner loop and recovery (`packages/control-plane/src/planner-loop.ts`, `packages/control-plane/src/planner-recovery.ts`):** `PlannerLoop` runs on a fenced `PostgresLedgerStore`, derives deterministic command IDs via `plannerCommandIdFor` (`cmd_planner_` namespace, up to `MAX_ROUND_ATTEMPTS = 3`), commits T2 `task.dispatched.planner` and `journaled` in one transaction from `SCOPED` (or journals a T4 revision round with `PlannerRevision.earlierPlan` or a `not_sent`-only retry in `PLANNING`), checks `authorizeRoute` and `attest` before dispatch, requires `PlannerInit` (`initModel`, `conversationId`) on the `antigravity`/`google` lane, validates returned plans with `judgeRoundPlan` (logging value-free `planner.plan_refused` on refusal), and commits T3 `plan.submitted`, `PlanStore.recordPlan`, and `completed` in one transaction. `PlannerRecovery` verifies the journal from genesis (`journal.verify()`) before reconciling any open command through `PlannerPort.reconcile` without re-execution.
- **Founder plan-decision route (`packages/control-plane/src/plan-decision.ts`):** `POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/plan-decision`, behind `PHASE3_ADJUDICATION_TOKEN` and `requireLeader`, re-reads the plan under review from `PlanStore` under the room lock, records T5 `plan.approved`, T4 `plan.revision_requested`, or post-planner-command T22 `founder.cancel` (marking any pending planner command `unresolved` with `unconfirmed-cancel` when unconfirmed), and commits the bound journal `decision` row (`PLAN_DECISION_AUTHORIZATION_REF`) in the same transaction.
- **Planner pull channel, Gateway worker, and Linux Antigravity executor (`packages/gateway-protocol/src/index.ts`, `packages/control-plane/src/gateway/planner-channel.ts`, `packages/gateway-daemon/src/planner-worker.ts`, `packages/gateway-daemon/src/planner-executor-factory.ts`, `packages/gateway-daemon/src/agy-planner-executor.ts`):** `GatewayPlannerChannel` delivers `attest`, `execute`, and `status` requests over the assigned Gateway's signed `planner_poll` and `planner_report` session messages. `GatewayPlannerWorker` and `PlannerRecordStore` maintain the worker's durable per-command records in the Gateway directory's `planner` folder for at-most-one execution, while `AgyPlannerExecutor` writes its per-command evidence records in the Gateway directory's `planner-evidence` folder and writes `planner-halted.json` in the Gateway directory itself. `choosePlannerExecutor` activates `AgyPlannerExecutor` only on Linux for Gateway `1880c12d-d98d-4a91-b25a-23320aa7f58a` (`AGY_PLANNER_GATEWAY_ID`) when `BUILDROOM_PLANNER_EXECUTOR=agy` and `BUILDROOM_PLANNER_USER`, `BUILDROOM_PLANNER_AGY`, `BUILDROOM_PLANNER_AGY_SHA256`, and `BUILDROOM_PLANNER_CHECKOUTS` are set, running headless `agy` via `sudo -n` with `PINNED_AGY_ARGUMENTS` on `AGY_PLANNER_LANE` (`architect`, `antigravity`, `google`, `gemini-4-argon`, effort `high`, `agyModel: 'gemini-4-argon-high'`), holding work back until `init.model` confirms `gemini-4-argon-high`, using a read-only anonymous checkout removed after each run, and reaping lingering planner-user processes; a wrong `agy` hash, a failed launch, or a wrong or missing `init` refuses that run only, whereas a failed planner-user check before a start, a failed cleanup after a run (the reap, the checkout's removal, or confirming `agy`'s exit), or a failed write or read of its evidence record writes `planner-halted.json` in the Gateway directory to halt further work.
- **Counted-run routes and Phase 4 harness (`packages/control-plane/src/counted-run.ts`, `packages/control-plane/src/counted-run-config.ts`, `packages/run-harness/src/phase4/cli.ts`, `packages/run-harness/src/phase4/runner.ts`, `packages/run-harness/src/phase4/http-driver.ts`, `packages/run-harness/src/phase4/entry.ts`, `packages/run-harness/src/phase4/run-unit.ts`):** `POST /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/planner-round`, `GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/planner-round`, and `GET /control-plane/rooms/:roomId/journal` sit behind `PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN_TOKEN` and `PHASE4_COUNTED_RUN` (503 when unset) and check `RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_ID` and `packages/control-plane/fixtures/execution-surface-registry.md` (`COUNTED_RUN_REGISTRY`). `npm run phase4:counted-run` runs one label (`Phase4-CR1`, `Phase4-CR2`, `Phase4-CR3`) per invocation, checks entry (`evaluatePhase4Entry`), runs the `Phase4-CR1` round-1 live check (`evaluatePhase4LiveCheck`), saves the plan at `PLAN_REVIEW` for the Founder without deciding it, and evaluates the run record (`evaluatePhase4Run`). Include the explicit authority note that nothing in the code authorizes a counted run, closes the Phase 4 stop gate, or authorizes Phase 5.
